statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-69522 (GHSA-2j8r-3c22-8565) is a remote code execution issue in Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native: an out-of-bounds write can occur when processing PDB files. Microsoft lists Windows as the only affected platform and the Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native NuGet package (17.12.0-beta1.24603.5 through 18.9.0-beta1.26405.1, fixed in 18.9.0-beta1.26405.2) as the only affected .NET 9 package (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-2j8r-3c22-8565, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/439, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.20/9.0.20.md). Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native consists of native Windows DLLs. DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold. None of them contains a Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native file or nupkg, and none contains a native Windows PE file; every PE file in them is a managed .NET assembly. The managed Microsoft.DiaSymReader library (version 2.2.0-beta.24327.2) is present in the dotnet-format and dotnet-watch tools of the SDK held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap and as Microsoft.DiaSymReader nupkg files in dotnet9-runtime-artifacts; it is a separate package that Microsoft does not list as affected. So the vulnerable native component is not in this owner.
